green-juice.title: Green Detox Smoothie
steps: Wash and roughly chop all fruits and vegetables.
Place everything into a blender, pour in coconut water.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

oat-bowl.title: Oat Bowl with Berries and Almonds
steps: Cook oats with milk for 5–7 minutes.
Divide into bowls, add berries and almonds.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

salmon-pancakes.title: Buckwheat Pancakes with Salmon and Avocado
steps: Mix flour, eggs, and milk until a smooth batter forms.
Cook thin pancakes in a dry pan.
Wrap with salmon, avocado, greens, and a squeeze of lemon.

avocado-toast.title: Rye Bread Toast with Quark and Poached Egg
steps: Toast the bread, spread with quark, sprinkle with lemon.
Poach eggs for 3 minutes.
Spread on toast, top with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cherry tomatoes.

walnut-porridge.title: Millet Porridge with Walnuts and Pear
steps: Rinse millet, cover with milk, and cook for 20 minutes.
Slice pear, toast walnuts in a dry pan.
Serve with pear, walnuts, cinnamon, and syrup.

chia-pudding.title: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
steps: Mix chia seeds with milk and honey, refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, dice the mango.
Layer the pudding with mango and shredded coconut on top.

egg-muffins.title: Spinach Egg Muffins
steps: Whisk eggs, chop vegetables, and mix.
Pour into oiled muffin molds.
Bake for 18 minutes at 180°C.

quinoa-bowl.title: Quinoa Bowl with Chickpeas and Roasted Veggies
steps: Cook quinoa for 15 minutes, roast vegetables for 20 minutes at 200°C.
Mix tahini with lemon and water to create a sauce.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa, vegetables, chickpeas, then drizzle with sauce.

salmon-rice.title: Baked Salmon with Wild Rice and Broccoli
steps: Cook rice for 25 minutes.
Drizzle salmon with oil and lemon, bake for 12 minutes at 200°C.
Steam broccoli for 5 minutes, serve all together.

chicken-buckwheat.title: Chicken Breast with Buckwheat and Braised Vegetables
steps: Cook buckwheat for 20 minutes.
Brown chicken and braise with vegetables for 15 minutes.
Serve with herbs and thyme.

lentil-soup.title: Lentil Soup with Turmeric and Lemon
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, turmeric, and broth, cook for 25 minutes.
Puree, then season with lemon juice.

tuna-salad.title: Tuna, Bean, and Egg Salad
steps: Hard boil eggs, chop them.
Combine salad, tuna, beans, and tomatoes.
Dress with oil and lemon.

turkey-meatballs.title: Turkey Meatballs with Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix ground turkey with onion, oats, and egg, form into meatballs.
Sear in olive oil until golden brown.
Simmer in tomato sauce with basil for 15 minutes.

veggie-frittata.title: Frittata with Spinach and Bell Pepper
steps: Sauté bell pepper for 3 minutes, add spinach.
Pour in beaten eggs with green onion.
Bake for 12 minutes at 180°C.

baked-cod.title: Baked Cod with Vegetables and Lemon
steps: Slice potatoes, bake for 15 minutes.
Add cod, cherry tomatoes, olives, and lemon.
Bake for another 12 minutes at 200°C.

chicken-stew.title: Moroccan Chicken & Veg
steps: Sauté chicken with spices for 5 minutes.
Add vegetables, chickpeas, apricots, and broth.
Simmer covered for 35 minutes.

mackerel.title: Baked Mackerel with Quinoa Salad
steps: Bake mackerel with lemon for 18 minutes at 200°C.
Cook quinoa for 15 minutes.
Mix quinoa with vegetables and greens, serve with fish.

beef-stirfry.title: Asian Beef Stir-fry
steps: Cook rice for 15 minutes.
Sear beef for 3 minutes over high heat.
Add vegetables and tamari, cook for another 4 minutes.

shrimp-zoodles.title: Shrimp Zoodles with Pesto
steps: Make pesto: blend basil, nuts, oil, garlic.
Spiralize zucchini, sauté for 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and pesto, cook for 4 minutes.

sweet-potato.title: Baked Sweet Potato with Chicken & Corn
steps: Bake sweet potato for 40 minutes at 200°C.
Sauté chicken and chop.
Cut sweet potato, fill with chicken, corn, and lime.

berry-pancakes.title: Oat Berry Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana, mix with flour, eggs, milk, and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in a dry pan.
Serve with berries and syrup.

filo-spiral.title: Cabbage Filo Spiral
steps: Braise cabbage without oil until soft, season with salt.
Lay a sheet of filo pastry, place a strip of filling.
Roll it into a log, then coil into a spiral.
Lightly spray with avocado oil, bake for 25 min at 190°C until golden.

buckwheat-waffles.title: Buckwheat Waffles with Banana & Walnut
steps: Mash the banana, mix with flour, eggs, milk, and baking powder.
Cook in a waffle maker for 4 minutes.
Serve with banana, nuts, and honey.

banana-pancakes.title: Banana Pancakes with Almond Butter
steps: Mash bananas, mix with eggs, flour, and cinnamon.
Cook small pancakes in a dry pan for 2 min per side.
Serve with almond butter and honey.

cottage-bowl.title: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Strawberry & Almond
steps: Divide cottage cheese into bowls.
Top with strawberries, almonds, and honey.

pumpkin-cream-soup.title: Pumpkin Ginger Cream Soup (Thermomix)
steps: Thermomix: onion and ginger 5 sec/spd 5, sauté 3 min.
Add pumpkin, carrot, and broth, cook 20 min/100°C/spd 1.
Puree 1 min/spd 10, pour in milk.
Serve with seeds.

cauliflower-cream-soup.title: Cauliflower Cream Soup (Thermomix)
steps: Thermomix: leek 5 sec/spd 5, sauté 3 min.
Add cauliflower, potato, and broth, cook 20 min/100°C/spd 1.
Puree 1 min/spd 10, add milk and nutmeg.
Serve with baked cauliflower florets.

lemon-chicken.title: Lemon Rosemary Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, garlic, and rosemary for 15 minutes.
Bake with vegetables for 25 min at 200°C.
Cook quinoa for 15 minutes, serve together.

chicken-stirfry.title: Chicken Stir-fry with Vegetables and Rice
steps: Cook rice.
Sear chicken for 4 min over high heat.
Add vegetables, ginger, and tamari, cook for 5 min.
Serve with rice and sesame.

turkey-burgers.title: Turkey Patties with Sweet Potato
steps: Slice sweet potato, bake for 30 min at 200°C.
Form patties, fry 4 min per side.
Serve with salad.

zucchini-fritters.title: Zucchini Fritters with Yogurt
steps: Grate zucchini, squeeze out juice.
Mix with eggs, flour, and dill.
Fry fritters for 2 minutes per side.
Serve with yogurt.

beef-stew.title: Braised Beef with Vegetables
steps: Sear beef for 5 minutes.
Add onion, carrot, simmer for 10 minutes.
Add potato, tomatoes, broth, and spices.
Braise covered for 60 minutes.

syrniki.title: Syrniki with Berries and Honey
steps: Mash cottage cheese with eggs, honey, and vanilla.
Add flour, knead into a soft dough.
Form syrniki, fry for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with berries and sour cream.

baked-apples.title: Baked Apples with Nuts and Honey
steps: Remove apple cores with a spoon.
Mix nuts, oats, raisins, cinnamon, and honey.
Fill apples with the mixture.
Bake for 25 mins at 180°C.

banana-blueberry-muffins.title: Banana Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mash bananas with a fork, mix with eggs, yogurt and honey.
Add flour and baking powder, gently fold in the blueberries.
Divide batter between muffin tins.
Bake for 20 mins at 180°C until golden.

grill-rolls.title: Grilled Chicken Sushi Rolls
steps: Cook rice, season with rice vinegar.
Grill chicken, cut into strips.
Lay rice on nori, add cheese, cucumber, and chicken. Roll tightly.
Bake rolls for 6 min at 200°C, slice, sprinkle with sesame seeds.

spring-rolls.title: Chicken and Veggie Spring Rolls
steps: Boil chicken and cut into strips.
Cut vegetables into thin strips.
Soak rice paper for 5 sec in warm water.
Add filling, fold into an envelope. Serve with peanut butter and tamari sauce.

chicken-wrap.title: Chicken & Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Sauté chicken with pepper for 8 minutes, then cut.
Place filling and cheese on half of a tortilla, fold over.
Fry for 2 min per side until cheese melts.
Serve with avocado cubes, cilantro, and lime.

khachapuri.title: Easy Egg Khachapuri
steps: Knead yeast dough, let rise for 30 min.
Form boats, add cheese filling.
Bake for 15 min at 220°C, crack egg into the center.
Bake for another 4 min, sprinkle with greens.

mushroom-cream-soup.title: Mushroom Cream Soup (Thermomix)
steps: Thermomix: onion + garlic 5 sec/sp.5, sauté 3 min/Varoma.
Add mushrooms and potatoes, cook 18 min/100°C/sp.1 with broth.
Puree 1 min/sp.10, pour in cream.
Serve with sautéed mushrooms and greens.

turkey-roast.title: Roasted Turkey Thigh with Vegetables
steps: Roughly chop vegetables and arrange in a baking dish.
Rub turkey with oil, garlic, rosemary, and salt.
Bake for 50 minutes at 190°C.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice.

lentil-waffles.title: Lentil Waffles with Avocado and Tofu
steps: Soak lentils overnight, drain.
Blend lentils, grated zucchini, psyllium, and spices.
Bake in a waffle maker until golden brown (~7 waffles).
Serve 2 waffles with avocado slices, tofu, ajvar, and a drizzle of flaxseed oil.
lentil-waffles.brainNote: High protein + fiber + healthy fats — an ideal pre-workout balance.
lentil-waffles.childFriendlyNote: Crispy waffles — kids love to eat them.

pumpkin-waffles.title: Pumpkin Waffles with Yogurt and Seeds
steps: Mix pumpkin puree, flour, eggs, milk, and cinnamon.
Bake in a waffle maker for 4–5 minutes.
Serve with yogurt, seeds, and syrup.
pumpkin-waffles.brainNote: Beta-carotene and magnesium from pumpkin seeds.
pumpkin-waffles.childFriendlyNote: Sweet and bright — kids love them.

broccoli-cream-soup.title: Broccoli Cream Soup (Thermomix, 25 min)
steps: Thermomix: onion + garlic 5 sec/sp.5, sauté 3 min/Varoma/sp.1.
Add broccoli, potatoes, and broth, cook 18 min/100°C/sp.1.
Puree 1 min/sp.10, add cream, season with salt.
Serve with seeds and a drizzle of oil.

turkey-spinach.title: Turkey meatballs in spinach sauce
steps: Cook rice for 25 minutes.
Form meatballs from minced meat and onion, fry for 6 minutes.
Pour in cream and spinach, simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with rice.
turkey-spinach.childFriendlyNote: Tender creamy sauce — kids love it.

salmon-poke.title: Salmon poke with quinoa and peas
steps: Cook quinoa for 15 minutes.
Dice salmon, marinate in tamari and lime.
Assemble bowl: quinoa, salmon, peas, cucumber, sesame.

protein-brownies.title: Healthy brownies with cocoa and raspberries
steps: Mash bananas with a fork, mix with eggs, honey and milk.
Add flour, cocoa and baking powder, mix until smooth.
Pour into a mold, arrange raspberries on top.
Bake for 22 minutes at 180°C. Cool and slice.
protein-brownies.childFriendlyNote: A dessert that can even be for breakfast.

cottage-casserole.title: Cottage cheese casserole with berries
steps: Soak semolina in milk for 15 minutes.
Mix cottage cheese with eggs, honey, and semolina.
Add berries, put into a baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes at 180°C. Serve with sour cream.

berry-smoothie.title: Milk smoothie with strawberry and banana
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until creamy.
Serve immediately.
berry-smoothie.brainNote: Glucose and vitamin C — quick energy.

cocoa-smoothie.title: Milkshake with cocoa and banana
steps: Place all in a blender, blend for 30 seconds.
Serve immediately with a pinch of cocoa on top.

mango-smoothie.title: Tropical Mango-Passion Fruit Smoothie
steps: Peel the mango and cut into cubes.
Combine with yogurt, honey, and milk in a blender.
Blend, pour into glasses, and top with a spoonful of passion fruit.
mango-smoothie.brainNote: Vitamin C and antioxidants for immunity.

nut-mix.title: Nut and Dried Fruit Mix
steps: Lightly toast the nuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Mix with dried fruits.
Store in a jar for up to a week.
nut-mix.brainNote: Omega-3 fats + quick glucose = ideal snack between games.

veggie-sticks.title: Veggie Sticks with Hummus
steps: Cut vegetables into long sticks.
Arrange on a plate with a bowl of hummus.

healthy-sandwich.title: Healthy Sandwich with Avocado and Cottage Cheese
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread cottage cheese, arrange avocado and cucumber slices.
Top with cherry tomato halves, salt, and pepper.

pp-pizza.title: PP-Pizza Margherita
steps: Knead a dough from flour, warm milk, yeast, and oil. Let it rise for 30 minutes.
Roll out a thin base, spread with tomato sauce.
Arrange mozzarella and cherry tomatoes.
Bake for 12 minutes at 220°C. Sprinkle with basil.
pp-pizza.childFriendlyNote: A favorite dish for family dinner.

chicken-meatball-soup.title: Soup with Chicken Meatballs and Pasta
steps: Form small meatballs from minced chicken.
Sauté vegetables for 5 minutes, then pour in broth.
Add meatballs, cook for 10 minutes.
Add pasta, cook for another 7 minutes. Sprinkle with greens.
chicken-meatball-soup.childFriendlyNote: Light and hearty, kids love it.
